newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania sees further rise in sunflower output.
newsitem.headline: Romania sees further rise in sunflower output.

text.p: Romania's agriculture ministry said on Tuesday it expected another bumper sunflower crop of 1.21 million tonnes in 1997 after last year's good crop of 1.09 million.
Ministry estimates put average sunflower yields at 1.55 tonnes per hectare on the 780,844 ha under the crop.
Ministry officials said the forecast was being made despite flooding in recent months which damaged over 54,000 hectares of sunflower.
The private sector would account for the bulk of this year's crop, official data showed.
Ministry officials could not immediately comment on prospects for sunflower oil or meal exports or imports.
Last year's sunflower crop yielded around 420,000 tonnes of sunflower oil -- enough to meet local demand, with a surplus of some 200,000 tonnes available for export.
